## Change and validation

Describe the behavior change and the evidence that verifies it.

## D1 quota impact

Link the current `docs/d1-quota-reviews/*.json` record for package, script,
workflow or dependency changes (including shared SQL and Unicode data).
Explain a no-impact decision; otherwise include before/after read/write costs,
account-wide workload/reserve, local evidence, and rollout/stop conditions.
See [the quota policy](../docs/d1-quota-policy.md). Passing semantic tests or
checking storage alone is not sufficient. Unknown cost blocks remote execution.
